description: Seznam javno dostopnih WiFi točk v Občini Šentjernej is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA ŠENTJERNEJ. List of publicly accessible WiFi points in the Municipality of Šentjernej. The collection contains the name of the point, the location coordinate, the speed and the provider. Coverage: OBČINA ŠENTJERNEJ. The portal shows the English title as "List of publicly accessible WiFi points in the Municipality of Šentjernej" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA ŠENTJERNEJ. Its keywords include dostopne točke, Wi-Fi. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
